guides.requests: Review the applicant → confirm academic details → approve. A student account and code are created only after approval.
guides.access: Choose an open admission period, create a PIN/QR invitation, then share its poster. The availability badge includes period dates, quota and lockout.
guides.periods: Set the academic year and Cairo opening/closing times, then enable the period. Invitations follow this schedule.
guides.groups: Choose a configured academic year and level, then set capacity. Assigning a group during approval is optional.
guides.codes: Use the audit to understand ownership. A review finding does not mean that a code can be given to someone else.
guides.imports: Download the template → preview the workbook → confirm valid rows. The preview never changes student records.

admissionWorkflow.expectedCodeStart: New codes for {year} must start with {start}. Review the saved year mapping before approval.
admissionWorkflow.mappingContactAdmin: An administrator must review and correct this year mapping.

control.restoredDraft: Your unsaved draft was restored. Review the current marks and scheme, then retry saving.
control.schemeChanged: The grading scheme changed. Refresh it, review your draft against the new maximum and allocation, then retry saving.
control.keepMine: Keep my mark after reviewing the conflict
control.retryCheckpoint: Could not save your position · Retry
control.name: Student name
control.saveFailed: Save failed; your edits are retained
control.conflict: Saved value changed to {score}. Discard your draft to reload, then re-enter if needed.
control.saveBeforeLeaving: Save or discard pending changes before leaving.
control.invalidMark: Enter a valid mark within the maximum and step.
control.invalidCoursework: Enter both contributions within their configured limits; total must be at most 20.
control.reasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters, then select the status again.
control.scoreRequired: A mark is required for this student and cannot be empty when present
control.scoreNotAllowed: This state (absent / excused / banned) carries no numerical mark
control.statesPermissionDenied: Setting this special state requires control states management permission
control.reasonRequiredValidation: A valid reason of at least 3 characters is required for this state
control.unpublishRequired: Hide results on the Grades page before editing published marks
control.useClear: Use Clear marks to remove an entry.
control.sheetStatusHint: Sheet status: Open allows authorized grade entry; Locked is read-only and managed by Control admins.
control.stateReasonOptional: Reason (optional for exam statuses and excuses)
control.empty: No approved registrations or existing marks in this sheet.
control.reviewExplanation: Sending the sheet stops your grade entry and editing and passes it to Control for review. This does not publish results to students.
control.sendApprovalExplanation: Sending for approval stops editing until the approval decision.
control.approvalExplanation: Approval confirms that the sheet has been reviewed. It does not publish results to students.
control.returnExplanation: Return the sheet so the responsible user can correct its marks.
control.reopenExplanation: Reopen the sheet to correct its marks and review it again.
control.clearExplanation: Clear the selected students' marks for this component only.
control.readinessTuitionDeferred: Deferred for a tuition hold: {count}. The remaining sheet can be approved. Blank marks remain unentered, never zero or absent. After the hold is lifted, enter and review these marks before publishing them.
control.readinessWarning: There are {missing} students without marks. Are you sure you want to continue? Their entries stay blank until completed and are never treated as zero or absent.
control.previewCount: {count} valid rows. Review changes and errors before confirming. Blank cells are left unchanged.
control.partialFailure: Some rows failed. Refresh and inspect the row results before retrying.
control.visibilityNote: Draft marks are hidden. After Control approval, publish on the Grades page. Students see results only while their Grades window is open.
control.courseworkNote: Coursework /20 = attendance /{attendance} + quizzes /{quizzes}. These are awarded contributions; source results are never copied automatically. Configure the split before entering coursework.
control.splitNote: Default: attendance 5 + quizzes 15 = 20. Enter each awarded contribution, not the raw quiz score. The split is frozen once coursework marks exist.
control.frozenNote: Marked components are frozen. Clear draft marks before changing the scheme; no force rescaling is performed.
control.calculationNote: Calculation guide: attendance ratio x attendance allocation; quiz earned/maximum ratio x quiz allocation. Round the awarded contributions to the configured entry step and review before saving. Later source changes never overwrite these marks.
control.finalDraftNote: Approve coursework, midterm and final, then preview and activate the official course result on Grades. The versioned result policy controls pass thresholds and retakes.
control.schemeHelpTitle: How does the grading scheme work?
control.midtermStatusOnly: Midterm accepts present, absent or banned only.
control.tuitionEntryLocked: Grade entry is locked during the tuition hold. Lift the hold in the student record and reload the sheet. Existing marks are preserved.
control.icCarriedLocked: IC contributions are retained; enter the summer final only.
control.schemeHelpBody: Coursework is fixed at 20: choose the attendance allocation and quizzes receive the remainder. Default: attendance 5 + quizzes 15. Midterm and final maximums are configurable; for example, 20 + 30 + 50 = 100. Enable a component to allow grade entry.
control.entryHelpBody: New sheets default to an increment of 1 (whole numbers). You can set 0.5 to allow 15, 15.5 and 16. New defaults: coursework 20, midterm 30, final 50. Example: attendance 4 + quizzes 13 = coursework 17, plus midterm 25 and final 38 gives 80/100. Saved schemes keep their existing allocation. Midterm accepts present, absent or banned only; absence or a ban contributes zero to that exam. Final statuses remain available and preserve midterm/coursework contributions. Final ban = FX, incomplete = IC, failure = F.
control.freezeHelpTitle: Saving a scheme does not recalculate marks
control.freezeHelpBody: The coursework split freezes after coursework entry starts. A component's maximums and increments freeze once its marks exist. Existing marks are not automatically rescaled or overwritten when attendance or quiz source data changes.
control.visibilityHelpTitle: Confirming does not publish student results
control.visibilityHelpBody: Confirm saves scheme settings only. Drafts need Control approval and Grades publication; staff require a different reviewer, while admin may self-approve. Students see enabled midterm/final columns during the viewing window. Coursework is always hidden and counts toward official totals. Instructors control quiz visibility independently.
control.schemeValidation: Use finite maximums and increments from 0.01 to 1000 with at most two decimal places. The increment cannot exceed the maximum. Attendance must be between 0 and 20.
control.previewReady: Preview complete: {valid} valid, {invalid} invalid, {skipped} blank rows skipped.
control.fileInputHelp: Enter marks in score or the active component column (for example midterm). Other components are reference only. Correct conflicting edits. Blank rows are skipped; previewing never saves grades.
control.noImportChanges: No marks to import. Enter a mark in score or the active component column, save the XLSX file, and select it again.
control.fileSizeError: The file is empty or exceeds 2 MB.
control.batchHelp: Preview all batches before uploading; each batch contains up to 500 rows.
control.batchWarning: Each batch saves independently. Invalid rows are skipped. Completed batches remain saved if upload stops; retry safely without repeating them. Review errors before continuing.
control.batchChanged: This batch changed or has new validation errors since preview. Reopen and preview the file before continuing; completed batches remain saved.
control.batchFinishedWithErrors: Processing finished: {saved} rows saved and {invalid} rows need correction. Review each batch's errors, correct those rows and preview a fresh file.

controlAttempts.undoHelp: Removes only the two copied summer contributions. Original attempt marks and the summer final remain. Reopen the sheets and remove approvals first if they were approved.
controlAttempts.title: Attempt comparison and IC carry-forward
controlAttempts.description: Review the whole attempt before final approval. Hidden historical marks stay hidden; retaining them does not publish them.
controlAttempts.rules: Compare whole-course percentages when maximums differ. Never mix components from different attempts. Lower or equal results keep the previous attempt. Higher results can be approved, or you may keep the previous result. Changes require a fresh review. IC preserves midterm/coursework and is not a finalized failure.
controlAttempts.retain: Keep previous — new attempt is not higher or is incomplete
controlAttempts.noComparisons: No previous completed result in this scope.
controlAttempts.icHelp: Carry the original midterm/coursework, then enter the summer final only. Approved summer registration, entry/review permissions and permission to open component sheets when needed are required. Original maximums must match; no rescaling. Carried marks are read-only and the new sheets still require normal approval.
controlAttempts.changed: Comparison changed. Refresh and review your choices.

controlRelease.historicalImportHelp: For previous academic years, download the Excel template and use one row per student and course with coursework, midterm and final columns, plus year and semester. Default maxima are 20 / 30 / 50; optional maximum and status columns apply to each component separately. Leave unavailable components blank; zero is a real mark. The older one-row-per-component format is also supported. Existing grades and Control sheets are protected, identical retries are safe, and imported marks stay hidden.
controlRelease.reviewHelp: Enter marks and submit the sheet for review in Control. Approval confirms review; it does not publish student results.
controlRelease.publishHelp: Select the course and component, preview approved marks, then publish that preview. The official final course outcome requires all required components to be approved.
controlRelease.visibilityHelp: Enable the portal, level and midterm or final, and set viewing dates above. Showing a column does not publish unapproved or unpublished marks.
controlRelease.actionHelp: Preview does not change student results. Publishing activates a saved approved snapshot; no extra certification step is required. Withdrawal hides the selected component without deleting Control marks. Coursework only contributes to the official total.
controlRelease.withdrawHelp: Withdraw publication of the selected component for this course, term and year (or every course if selected). Students will no longer see this snapshot. Control marks and release history remain saved. For temporary hiding, use the visibility settings above.
controlRelease.title: Control releases and official results
controlRelease.description: Preview approved marks, then activate a complete release. Corrections keep the previous published version visible until a replacement is activated.
controlRelease.openFirst: Open this component in Control and complete its review first.
controlRelease.windowNote: The existing Grades opening/closing window still controls student access.
controlRelease.policyNote: Policy freezes after the first release. Set component maximums in the Control grading scheme. Existing grade-scale thresholds remain in effect.
controlRelease.uploadNote: Upload midterm, coursework and final marks from the course's Control sheet. Download its scoped Excel template, preview, and commit there.
controlRelease.emptyHelp: Check that courses are active in Courses. Staff also need a course assignment and Control permissions for this term. Existing marks alone do not create a course.
